featureFlags._doc: Runtime feature flags read at Electron startup. Do NOT rely on these for security-critical defaults — a stale version.json on an offline client stays at the shipped values. Security-critical changes must land as code pushes with a version bump.

notes: v1.34.0: deeper Meta reporting, sharper creative guidance, and the v1.33.0 workstreams that had not yet shipped. NEW IN v1.34.0. (1) META AUDIT READS: Merlin can now pull your ad account's change history (who changed what, and when), day-by-day delivery breakdowns, and account health (spend cap, account status, and any disable reason) as read-only insights, with platform rate limits respected on every call. (2) CREATIVE AND OFFER FRAMEWORKS: creative guidance now includes a test-prioritization method (ICE) that feeds the existing statistical Promotion Gate, an offer and copy persuasion-lever catalog, an objection taxonomy for objection-led ads, a named-mechanism method, and a per-platform ad character-limit reference. (3) ROUTING AND DOC FIXES: two mis-routed ad-tool references corrected, a skill-routing gap closed, and a documentation cleanup pass. This release also carries every v1.33.0 workstream, which shipped together below. v1.33.0: Intel Macs, a full design pass, and a security + accuracy sweep. Anchor: 2026-07-05. Five workstreams shipped together. (1) INTEL MAC SUPPORT (mac-compat): Merlin now installs and runs end-to-end on Intel (x86_64) Macs, which had been broken since install two months ago. Per-architecture DMGs (the x64 DMG no longer ships an arm64 Node runtime or arm64-only voice tools), ffprobe bundled on mac, the in-app updater now matches the correct-architecture asset (Intel installs had been handed the arm64 zip), a declared macOS version floor with a clear message below it, an x64 mac smoke test in CI, and the self-update path now verifies the downloaded binary against the release checksums.txt before replacing the running engine (previously it self-replaced with no integrity check). (2) DESIGN PASS (design-polish): an Apple-tier UI sweep with a consolidated design-token system (spacing, radius, shadow, typography, and z-index scales), a unified interaction and motion layer, and copy unification across the app. (3) PERFORMANCE + MONEY-SAFETY (perf-rsi): reports for every window (1 day to 12 months) plus live ad data and the funnel now stream and prefetch in the background so 90-day and 12-month views open instantly; message sends are wedge-proof with no stuck states; the dashboard shares a single orders/charges fetch instead of duplicating it; and several money and metrics accuracy fixes landed across the engine and workers. (4) SECURITY HARDENING (security RSI): a six-auditor adversarial pentest plus independent verification closed the real gaps. The desktop command guard now enforces its destructive-command and app-source-write blocklists from stdin and fails closed (the prior inline hooks read an env variable the SDK never sets, so they silently failed open); the brand-scraper SSRF fence now canonicalizes integer, hex, octal, short-form, and IPv4-mapped-IPv6 addresses before its private-range checks; renderer platform badges escape their class attributes; the main window has a navigation lock; OAuth entropy generation fails fast on a crypto/rand error; the wisdom worker fails closed by default when its signing key is unset; and CSP plus nosniff headers are now consistent across landing and wisdom responses. (5) CREATIVE HARNESS (corpus): the creative-generation corpus now fails loudly on fal generation errors and paces reference uploads. No user action is required for any of this.
whatsNew: See exactly what changed in your ad account and when: Merlin now pulls your account's change history, day-by-day delivery breakdowns, and account health (spend caps and status) as read-only reports.
Merlin now installs and runs on Intel Macs, and updates verify their download before applying. If you are on an older (Intel) Mac, install and auto-update finally work end to end.
A cleaner, faster app: a full design pass (spacing, motion, and typography) plus performance work, so reports for every time window open instantly and sends never get stuck.
